# Prompt library for supported IDEs

These `.prompt.md` files are reusable Copilot prompt starters for repository maintainers and workshop facilitators.

## Compatibility notes

- Prompt files are an editor and preview feature. Support varies by IDE, extension version, and GitHub Copilot surface.
- When a client does not understand `.prompt.md` frontmatter, these files still remain useful as plain Markdown prompts.
- Keep portable workshop copies in the top-level `prompts/` directory when that library is available; `.github/prompts/` is primarily for IDE-assisted authoring.
